module.name: Deezer instance
module.author: Natune contributors
module.description: Deezer public catalog matched against a user-configured plaintext instance. Probes FLAC/MP3 bytes; never returns public previews. Direct ARL encrypted streams require Natune native playback and are not part of API v1.

instanceUrl.label: Instance URL
instanceUrl.description: Your HTTPS community or private instance; no built-in account or server list.

instanceToken.label: Instance token
instanceToken.description: Optional access credential for your own instance.
